notes: 24 fps material on the 60 fps grid (3:2 cadence, local_fps 23.6-24.6): all durations +-1-3 f.
Edge boundaries f2415 (c069) and f3042 (c086) decided here by looking 15 frames past each edge; v5c3 and v5c5 see the same cuts.
c4S1 is MIXED only because its cards carry photographic stills; c4S2 window carries moving footage; c4S3 is full-frame footage with captions. No LIVE segment in range.

Whip pans f2442-f2617 are 3D camera moves over one curved canvas (side cards turned toward the camera, outer edge ~7% taller; wide card concave, top edge sags 1.6% H), not boundaries; only the vertical whip replaces the layout.
Camera rhythm in c4S1: whip 25 f - hold 13 - whip 30 - hold 22 - whip ~33 - hold ~17 - pull-back 35 - 5 - tilt 46; settles land within 6 f of a beat (2467 -3, 2510 +6, 2565 -4, 2668 +1).
Card geometry: portrait cards aspect 0.80-0.83 frontal, corner radius 7-7.5% of card width, no border or shadow; labels centred 7.5-7.9% of card height below.
Camera moves inside the footage (c4S3, c4S2 window) were not analysed; the speaker icon is ignored.
